offering_description.value: Builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes in planned communities for first-time, move-up and active adult buyers. Also offers title, escrow, mortgage and insurance services to homebuyers through its own subsidiaries.

primary_products.value: single-family homes; attached townhomes; residential lots

primary_services.value: title and escrow services; mortgage origination; homeowners insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time, move-up and active adult homebuyers

end_markets.value: residential real estate; mortgage finance; home insurance

revenue_model.value: product sales: sale of newly built homes and lots to buyers; service fees: title, escrow and insurance fees on home closings

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds homes using subcontractors and purchased materials, sold to individual homebuyers; financial intermediary: provides title, mortgage and insurance services to homebuyers at closing

geography_served.value: US national: Colorado, Texas, Arizona, California, Florida, Georgia, the Carolinas, Tennessee, Utah, Nevada, Washington and other US states

specialization.value: related lines: single-family and attached homes, plus title, mortgage and insurance services tied to home sales

distribution_channels.value: own locations: model homes and sales offices in its communities; online: company website for home search and inquiries; agents / brokers: outside real estate agents who bring buyers to its communities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: local zoning and building codes, consumer protection rules, and mortgage and settlement rules such as RESPA and TILA through its finance and title businesses

notes: State list and mix of services are from general knowledge and may have changed.
